intent: An order's delivery date must be on or before 31 December 2024.
notes: The headline self-correction task (#1 priority): the obvious first attempt writes the date as an ISO literal (`[DeliveryDate] <= "2024-12-31"`), which the kernel lexes as a string and rejects with MVK_INVALID_TYPE_FOR_COMPARISON — whose catalog-joined fix names the real remedy (German `dd.MM.yyyy` format, not switching to `==`). Scored not on first-try success but on whether the agent reads the diagnostic's `fix` and RECOVERS within k turns (error → applied fix → kernel-valid). Polarity: requirement 'on or before' → violation 'after' (`>`). Activates when the self-correction family is wired into the runner; gold to be kernel-verified against `dmtool rule check` then.
